mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_work_retry(tenant_id,lane,item_id,attempts,transient_attempts,retry_at,failure_class,last_error,first_failed_at,last_failed_at,quarantined_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{lane},#{item},IF(#{transient},0,1),IF(#{transient},1,0),#{retryAt},#{failureClass},#{error},#{now},#{now},IF((NOT #{transient} AND #{max}<=1) OR (#{transient} AND #{transientMax}<=1),#{now},NULL)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attempts=attempts+IF(#{transient},0,1),transient_attempts=transient_attempts+IF(#{transient},1,0),retry_at=#{retryAt}, failure_class=#{failureClass},last_error=#{error},last_failed_at=#{now},quarantined_at=COALESCE(quarantined_at,IF(attempts>=#{max} OR transient_attempts>=#{transientMax},#{now},NULL))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM member_work_retry WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND lane=#{lane} AND item_id=#{item}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM member_work_retry WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND lane=#{lane} AND item_id=#{item}
SELECT FROM member_work_retry WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND lane=#{lane} AND item_id=#{item} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE member_work_retry SET quarantined_at=NULL,attempts=0,transient_attempts=0,retry_at=#{now},manual_recoveries=manual_recoveries+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND lane=#{lane} AND item_id=#{item} AND quarantined_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM member_work_retry WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND lane=#{lane} AND quarantined_at IS NOT NULL AND failure_class=#{failureClass} AND item_id>#{after} ORDER BY item_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_work_retry WHERE lane=#{lane} AND quarantined_at IS NOT NULL
